_doc: Map 0 (Crossroads Inn) settings not in the generic tables. power: the cellar lever (T&C M2, T-027). exfil: the campaign beacon (T-033): lights when round `round` starts, stays open window_seconds, then again every retry_rounds rounds; a vote at the beacon leaves for `target` through cutscene `cutscene` (data/gravelight/campaign.json). position/yaw in the map frame (yaw 0 = the beacon's front faces -Z). opens_zone: that zone's doors open for free when the beacon lights, so the exfil is always reachable.

ladders._doc: T-229 the Hochsitz; T-230: the body climbs the ladder line 0.4 m off the rungs (line), facing the tower (face, default yaw + 180)

horses.name: YardHorse
horses._doc: T-240 the carters' Noriker, tied at a hitching rail under the hoist ledge by the stable's south wall (east of the Thompson chalk at x 22, 6 m from the zip line's landing post, across the yard from the tower's ladder). yaw 0 = it faces north, toward the rail and the wall. zones: where it may stand (the yard; the grounds once the gate is open): it refuses the stable's door, the inn and the tower. The rail's collider is on the map-edge layer (players are stopped, zombies and shots pass), so the baked navmesh is untouched. Tuning: data/gravelight/horse.json

round_bosses._doc: T-240 the undead horses (data/gravelight/bosses/horse.json; HorseRound). One line per boss round; a map without this block has none
T-249: on the Inn der Fuhrmann leads the round-30 horde that hits the Sherman (sherman_event): he is heard as the tank parks and comes in up the road behind it as the dead go for it

round_boss_arena._doc: T-240 where a horse goes on the Inn: the yard, the grounds and the stable (a 2.0 m door and an open floor); never the taproom, the stairs or the cellar (furniture, a staircase, a hatch). It comes up the carters' road (arrive) and breaks the yard's gate open if it is still chained; a player elsewhere is not chased (the siege rule).

sherman_event._doc: T-249 the Sherman (data/gravelight/sherman.json; ShermanEvent). Round 30: it comes in from beyond the south-east edge along the carters' road (route; it rolls over the sawhorse barrier at the road's exit), parks on the road outside the yard's gate facing it (park, park_yaw from the last leg) and the dead come for it; it covers the yard and the road from there for rounds 31..39 (it never moves into the yard: nothing baked changes, its hull collider is on the map-edge layer); round 40 a dive bomber kills it there and the bombs fall on the yard and the grounds (bomb_zones) while the inn (shelter_zones, inn_box) keeps everyone in it safe. A map without this block has no Sherman.
